MQTT_WIFI_TIP: Connects to WiFi (waits up to 15 seconds) and prints the IP in the console. The WiFi password is stored in the program, so remove it before sharing the project
MQTT_CONNECT_TIP: Connect to WiFi first. The prefix is optional and must match the prefix in the dashboard connection settings. Reconnects automatically if the connection drops
MQTT_SEND_TIP: Sends data to this topic (numbers, text or true/false). Dashboard value displays and charts receive it
MQTT_HAS_NEW_TIP: True once each time this topic receives new data. Use it in an "if", for example with a dashboard button
MQTT_NUMBER_TIP: The last number received on this topic. If the data has several numbers, picks one: for the dashboard joystick, x is #1 and y is #2. 0 until something arrives
MQTT_VALUE_TIP: The last data received on this topic (number, text or list), or None until something arrives. A topic is subscribed automatically the first time it is used
